The '''Holocron Chamber''' was a sealed room located in the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]], one of the five spires of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A branch of the expansive [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], it was presided over by the [[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker of First Knowledge]] and stored the [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] containing the majority of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] most coveted secrets. Holocrons stored within this chamber were being actively studied or consulted, therefore they were not held in the [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vault]].<ref name="SWR:D" />

==History==
[[File:TowerFirstKnowledge.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker of First Knowledge]] [[Astaal Vilbum]] consults a holocron.]]
Though the original towers of the Temple were destroyed in [[3653 BBY]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] by the resurgent [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Timeline 1 note">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}: Towers are visible on Ziggurat</ref> the Order, with help from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], was able to draw enough funds to rebuild them by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The chamber then came to house several of the most prized holocrons of the Order.<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

During the year [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], while the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] was dealing with [[Tinté Vos]]' demand for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] assistance on the plagued world [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]], a holocron containing information on the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Volfe Karkko]] activated for the first time in fourteen generations. Concerned over this, Caretaker [[Astaal Vilbum]] consulted [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] of the High Council, warning him of the dangers that awaited whoever was sent to Kiffex. Windu had already sent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] to investigate, causing him to send additional Jedi to assist in the defeat of the reawakened Karkko.<ref name="SWR:D" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] responsible for the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was discovered to be [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While the Jedi prepared the Temple for [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attack]], the few fully trained Knights and Masters stationed within were no match for the sheer number of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. Led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the clones swept through the Temple, slaughtering the Jedi and securing the complex's treasures. While many Jedi tried to escape with holocrons, most were cut down before they were able to escape.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

By the end of the night, the Temple was secured and most of the advanced holocron technology within the Chamber remained largely unscathed. Sidious' desire to plunder the Jedi's trove of Sith holocrons undoubtedly caused the chamber to be carefully picked apart, ensuring that any useful information be saved and preserved. While the room was left undisturbed for years after the initial study, in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Darth Vader's secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit|broke into]] the Tower of First Knowledge in order to complete the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. After killing the [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow Troopers]] stationed in the main entrance of the Tower, [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] was able to cross the damaged bridge leading to the chamber. Inside, he found a large holocron resting on the rotunda's central pedestal. When activated a [[Kento Marek|Gatekeeper]] demanded the assassin complete the [[Jedi Trials/Legends#Trial of the Spirit|Trial of Spirit]] in the bowels of the Temple. Leaving the chamber, the Sith apprentice found himself in competition with a [[Sith Warrior (Galen Marek)|twisted version]] of himself. After defeating the Stalker, he left the Temple, the Trials complete.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

The chamber would once more lay in silence for another decade, standing even after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was driven off Coruscant. With the resurgent [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] growing, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] entered the ruined edifice to find any information on the Order's teachings. However, his search was short lived; although [[Jedi historian]] [[Tionne Solusar]] was able to restore and scan the Archives, the Towers of the Temple were leveled by the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' eruption from beneath the planet's cityscape.<ref name="The Essential Chronology real-world book">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> While the Temple remained in use for several more years, the entire structure was ruined by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

A few years after Coruscant was secured by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] ordered the [[Reconstruction Authority]] to rebuild the Temple according to salvaged schematics. As the [[new Jedi Temple]] took shape, the Towers were restored to their former height, though they were encased in a large [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] pyramid. Every room restored, the Holocron Chamber once more held the Order's treasure for the next century.<ref name="FOTJO" />

==Layout==
Sealed off to all but [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], the rotunda contained the vast majority of the Order's most coveted Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]]. Located on the first level of the Tower of First Knowledge, the Chamber was set opposite the main entranceway. Accessible by a bridge that spanned the Spire's central chasm, Jedi had to pass through a sealed doorway to view the holocrons. The doorway was marked with the Order's crest, leading to a hall lined with pentagon-shaped consoles behind which several holocrons were stored.<ref name="TFU" /> The hall led into the rotunda, in the center of which sat a squat pedestal from which a holocron could be studied. Amidst the rotunda, several holocrons floated in a repulsorfield above the heads of visitors.<ref name="SWR:D" />
